entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right! We got a letter of introduction!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Just four more to go!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Just three more to go!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Just two more to go!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Just one more to go!

entries.speaker: Shadow Politician
entries.en: Please keep the truth of that subway[n]accident a secret...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Fine...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In any case... it turns out Principal[n]Kobayakawa was connected to Shido[n]after all...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No wonder he was so adamant about me[n]digging up information on the Phantom[n]Thieves.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Still, I can't believe Shido just killed him[n]so nonchalantly...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The entire nation is underwater in his[n]Palace. He must feel nothing toward[n]one measly educator.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: In any case, even though that politician[n]was cognitive, he turned into a monster.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Up until Kaneshiro's Palace, cognitive[n]beings were nothing more than weak[n]presences...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No... That Ooe fellow just now wasn't[n]a cognition.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm? But he had the memories and[n]appearance of an actual person...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: He was probably a Shadow fused with a[n]cognition... It's like making the Shadow[n]wear human skin.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I've never seen anything like that before...[n]Such power is normally impossible.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Wasn't Shido the one who[n]destroyed the research done by[n]Oracle's mother on cognition?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh! Do you think that when he did, he[n]took the results for his own purposes?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Shido...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: For all we know, Shido could have some[n]hidden trick that allows him to tamper[n]with his own Palace.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We need to be especially careful from[n]here on out!
